companyDescription: Space infrastructure + tactical UAS · Penguin/Stalker drones for NATO/US military + on-orbit space components · record $619.7M backlog (Q3 2026) · FY2026 revenue guide $450–500M rests on a back-end-loaded Q4
priceNote: Live $8.59 (+5.6%) on Nov 11, 2026 — down 11% from $9.63 at the Aug 4 report, after a ~-20% reaction to the Nov 4 Q3 print. Old report's primary catalyst (Aug 5 Q2 earnings) has passed; this refresh re-anchors on the Q4 delivery test.
summary: Refresh: the Aug 5 catalyst the old report was built around is long past, and the Nov 4 Q3 print split the story. Backlog hit a record $619.7M (up ~75% YoY) with a record 32.3% gross margin, but revenue of $109.0M missed by ~13% and free cash flow was -$66.4M, and the reaffirmed $450–500M full-year guide now needs a heavily back-end-loaded Q4 — the stock fell ~20% after the print. Liquidity is $538.9M after ~$567M of equity raised this year, so survival is not the question; dilution and Q4 deliveries are. There is no dated catalyst inside the ~6-week window this board hunts for: the next real test is the FY2026 print (~Q1 2027). So this is a HOLD, not a near-term catalyst play, and it will rank low on the board by design. Measured core median return to just after the catalyst is -6.7% (n=146): only the dip zone makes sense for new money.

risks: The $450–500M FY2026 guide depends on a heavily back-end-loaded Q4; any delivery slip makes it a guide cut.
Free cash flow was -$66.4M in Q3 (vs -$27.8M a year earlier) and inventory rose to $99.8M from $55.8M — working capital is absorbing the backlog growth.
~$567M of equity raised in 2026 means heavy dilution; more is possible even with $538.9M of liquidity.
The stock has missed and dropped on several recent prints (Q1 2026 -10.5%, Q3 2026 ~-20%).
No dated catalyst within the ~6-week window this board targets — capital tied up here waits for the FY print.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed hiked 25bp on Sep 16, 2026 (first hike since 2023), and a hot October CPI (core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected) has pushed Dec 9 FOMC hike odds to roughly 89–100%, with the 10-year near 4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: October CPI ran hot (headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3%); October PCE on Nov 25 is the next inflation read.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Defense demand supports the backlog, but a cash-burning, equity-funded small/mid cap is sensitive to higher-for-longer rates through dilution cost and multiple.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — rates matter mostly through financing; the bigger swing factor is Q4 execution.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Space/defense-infrastructure names in this cohort move on same-day contract-award and sector-tailwind headlines rather than a sustained pre-event grind — RDW's own 11.7% Monday pop (defense-funding + de-escalation news) fired the trading day before the print, echoing the pattern from its Jul 21 Stalker-order pop.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: 1-2 days pre-earnings on sector-wide tailwind / contract-pipeline optimism, not a multi-week runup
catalystSpot.preRunupPct: +10% to +12% in the day(s) just before the print (this cycle)

postWin.note: Rocket Lab jumped 12% on its $8B Iridium takeover (Jun 29, 2026); AST SpaceMobile jumped 12% on Trump's $1.2T Golden Dome estimates (Jul 22, 2026); Redwire's own Stalker follow-on order news drove a +9.5% pop on Jul 21, 2026 — this cohort rewards confirmed contract/beat news with same-day double-digit moves.

postLose.note: Redwire's own Q1 2026 print is the direct precedent: sales missed estimates and EPS surprise was -166.67%, sending the stock down 10.5% same-day; this followed an earlier miss + dilution overhang that had already pulled shares from $26.64 toward single digits. Sector capital also rotated away from names like SPCX (-23% YTD at points) during SpaceX's IPO.
